headline: Decline in Alcohol Consumption Is an Opportunity for Innovation, Says Director of Stock Company | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: Stock Plzeň-Božkov's managing director says falling alcohol consumption in the Czech Republic opens opportunities for innovation. The company is expanding into low-alcohol and ready-to-drink beverages.
why: Stock Plzeň-Božkov is a Czech spirits producer. Shifting consumer preferences affect volumes and product mix across the beverage sector.
